# TheSereyn.Methods.ProjectSlice — Copilot Instructions

## Project identity

This repository is the public home for the Project Slice Method, a planning-first, slice-based project delivery methodology.

This repo is intentionally lightweight at the start. Keep the work focused, readable, and easy to understand without requiring a specialized project tool.

## Naming and domain

- The repository namespace is `TheSereyn.Methods.ProjectSlice`.
- The domain `TheSereyn.Methods` is reserved for reusable project methods, operating models, and planning/delivery frameworks.
- Use the method name as the project-level identity, not as a general-purpose product namespace.

## Working rules

- Treat durable project state as repository files rather than chat history.
- Favor simple, Markdown-first planning artifacts.
- Keep the method understandable to a human without a dedicated PM tool.
- Preserve clear boundaries between project intent, roadmap, active slice, backlog, and inbox.
- Prefer small vertical slices that produce observable, testable outcomes.
- Capture tangential ideas in an Inbox rather than silently expanding active scope.

## Public repo expectations

- Keep guidance self-contained and easy to reuse outside the workspace.
- Do not assume private workspace-only automation or internals.
- Prefer clear documentation over repository-specific ceremony.
- If this repo grows, keep the method and examples clear enough to stand on their own.
